verseOfTheDay.sanskrit:
इति ते ज्ञानमाख्यातं गुह्याद्गुह्यतरं मया।
विमृश्यैतदशेषेण यथेच्छसि तथा कुरु॥
verseOfTheDay.transliteration:
iti te jñānam ākhyātaṁ guhyād guhyataraṁ mayā |
vimṛśyaitad aśeṣeṇa yathecchasi tathā kuru ||
verseOfTheDay.english: Thus I have explained to you wisdom still more secret than all secrecy. Ponder it fully, and then act as you choose.

thoughtOfTheDay.title: Tat Tvam Asi (Recognizing the Infinite Within)
thoughtOfTheDay.quote: तत्त्वमसि श्वेतकेतो — You are That, O Shvetaketu.
thoughtOfTheDay.reflection: When external social comparison tries to measure your worth by follower counts or peer achievements, step back. Your fundamental consciousness is unborn, complete, and boundless. Work with joy from fullness, not from a sense of lack.

dailyMantra.name: Gayatri Mantra
dailyMantra.sanskrit: ॐ भूर्भुवः स्वः तत्सवितुर्वरेण्यं भर्गो देवस्य धीमहि धियो यो नः प्रचोदयात्॥
dailyMantra.transliteration: oṁ bhūr bhuvaḥ svaḥ | tat savitur vareṇyaṁ | bhargo devasya dhīmahi | dhiyo yo naḥ pracodayāt ||
dailyMantra.meaning: We meditate upon the supreme effulgence of that luminous creator (Savitur) who pervades the physical, subtle, and celestial realms. May that Divine Light illuminate and awaken our intellect.
dailyMantra.benefit: Awakens cognitive clarity, dispels intellectual fog, and sharpens analytical intuition.
